snippet.title: Greediest Landlord - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Greediest Landlord – Dark Fantasy Incremental Strategy Game

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5185380/Greediest_Landlord/

Greediest Landlord is an upcoming incremental strategy game where you play as a solitary landlord determined to purge the humans settling in your lands. Harness dark magic, sinister powers, and strategic upgrades to defend your domain and grow stronger over time.

Greediest Landlord combines incremental gameplay, strategy, dark fantasy, resource management and progression systems into a twisted indie game experience.

If you enjoy incremental games, idle games, strategy games, dark fantasy games, management games, roguelikes, indie games, and unique game concepts, follow the development of Greediest Landlord.
